description: Two SessionStart hooks -- warn on session start, on resume and after /clear if the connected arknet MCP server is missing a tool or a tool parameter a shipped skill needs, and separately report which registered arknet project (if any) the current directory resolves to as an anchor, on startup, resume, /clear and after compaction -- plus nudge once per session if arknet's store was written but a discovered export snapshot in the project was not regenerated.
